# brandur.org

> > Personal site of Brandur Leach, a software engineer writing about Postgres, Go, API design, and building resilient systems.

This site features long-form technical articles, two newsletters (Nanoglyph on software sustainability and Passages on exploration/ideas), and practical guides on topics like idempotency, job queues, and distributed systems. Brandur previously worked at Heroku and writes extensively about database engineering and API architecture.

## Key Topics

- Postgres
- Go/Golang
- API design
- Idempotency
- Job queues
- Software engineering
- Heroku
- Database architecture
- MVCC (Multi-Version Concurrency Control)
- API versioning
- Shell scripting
- System design
- Newsletter publishing
- Terminal interfaces
- Distributed systems

## Essential Reading

- [Home — brandur.org](https://static.brandur.org): Personal site of Brandur: software engineer writing on Go, Postgres & APIs
- [Articles — brandur.org](https://brandur.org/articles): Long-form technical articles on Go, Postgres, APIs & software engineering
- [Implementing Stripe-like Idempotency Keys in Postgres — brandur.org](https://brandur.org/idempotency-keys): Stripe-style idempotency implementation in Postgres using atomic phases
- [Postgres Job Queues & Failure By MVCC — brandur.org](https://brandur.org/postgres-queues): Postgres job queue implementation challenges with MVCC and dead tuples

## Database & Backend Engineering

- [Kinesis Shard Splitting & Merging by Example — brandur.org](https://brandur.org/kinesis-by-example): AWS Kinesis resharding tutorial with practical examples of splits/merges
- [The Mediator Pattern — brandur.org](https://brandur.org/mediator): Rails Mediator Pattern for lean endpoints and testable business logic
- [Version Variants — brandur.org](https://brandur.org/version-variants): API versioning strategy using variants for prototypes & breaking changes

## Developer Tools & Workflows

- [Learning From Terminals to Design the Future of User Interfaces — brandur.org](https://brandur.org/interfaces): Terminal UI design principles vs Electron app performance issues
- [Dotfile Secrets and GPG — brandur.org](https://brandur.org/dotfile-gpg): Managing dotfile secrets with GPG encryption and gpg-agent integration
- [Command Exit Status — brandur.org](https://brandur.org/exit-status): Shell command exit codes for non-interactive CLI tools & two-factor auth
- [Pseudo-HTML and Pidgin CSS: Building an Email Newsletter — brandur.org](https://brandur.org/newsletters): Email newsletter architecture using Mailgun with HTML/CSS best practices
